person_made_it: Eric founded Sky Ship Studios in Madison in 2014 (project_eric_francksen.md; main's research of skyshipstudios.com); Gordon 10/18 00:43: 'that studio was Eric's creation .. i want a 3d animating flying living homage to the logo ... he closed the studio and that sacrifice has enabled many of the things he is now doing'
did_the_click_pay_me: tap parts the painted clouds with a whoosh; his own logo ship rises out of the cloud sea, orbits, and sails into the sun under an orchestral swell; the real logo then lands with a chime and the thank-you line writes in; tapping the sky or the logo ship banks it with a sparkle trail and a gust
told_me_the_truth: only two facts on the page: Madison and 2014; the logo is the real file, untouched; no claims about Gloom, the team, or why it closed
weakest: the ship in the video can't be hit-tested, so the bank delight moves the whole sky rather than the ship alone during flight
emcee_who_is_speaking: Darby, openly, with love from Gordon.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone-first 9:16 stage, tested in WebKit 390x844 and Chromium 1440x900; JS off shows the poster, logo, and full line.
taught_me_something: frames closing the studio as courage that powers what he builds now
